newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN THIRD DIVISION PLAYER FAILS DOPE TEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN THIRD DIVISION PLAYER FAILS DOPE TEST.

text.p: Third division player Cristian Biancone of Lodigiani has tested positive for a cocaine-based substance, Italy's soccer federation said on Tuesday.
The federation said in a statement that Biancone failed a dope test on March 29 at serie C1 club Acireale.
"The control sample opened today in the presence of representatives confirmed the athlete's positivity," the statement said.
The federation, which is to decide on further action, did not say how long a ban Biancone faced.
